options.title: Options
options.categoryHint: Context, not musical style — where the music comes from. You can change it later on any track.

forcedAlbum.legend: Gather the whole playlist under one album
forcedAlbum.problem: Music from a film, a series or a game belongs to different artists and different albums. Filed as they come, the tracks scatter: each one joins its original album, and the soundtrack exists nowhere.
forcedAlbum.effect: This gathers them under the album you name. Every track keeps its own artist and genre — only the filing changes.
forcedAlbum.singleHint: For a full album only — a single track has no playlist to gather.
